title: More places to discover
message: CornwallTap now includes 261 locations across Cornwall and the Isles of Scilly, giving you more variety and fewer familiar faces in the Daily Challenge.

title: A fresher Daily Challenge
message: We’ve made some behind-the-scenes improvements to help keep the Daily Challenge varied and reduce how often the same locations come back around.

title: Optional guess confirmation
message: You can now choose to confirm each guess before it is submitted, helping prevent accidental taps while moving or zooming the map.
